name: Variables & Types
description: Immutable and mutable variables with strings, numbers, bools, lists, and maps
code:
// Variables and Types
let name = "Alice"
let age = 30
let pi = 3.14159
let active = true
let colors = ["red", "green", "blue"]
let user = {name: "Bob", score: 95}

print("Pi: {pi}, Active: {active}")

name: Simple Pipeline
description: The |> operator passes values left-to-right through functions
code:
// Simple Pipeline
let result = "  hello world  "
  |> trim
  |> upper
print(result)

let nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
let doubled = nums |> map(x => x * 2)
print("Doubled: {doubled}")

let total = nums |> sum
print("Sum: {total}")

name: Chaining Transforms
description: Chain multiple operations into a readable data pipeline
code:
// Chaining Transforms
let words = ["hello", "world", "arc", "lang", "is", "cool"]
let result = words
  |> filter(w => len(w) > 3)
  |> map(upper)
  |> sort
  |> join(", ")
print(result)

let data = [5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7]
let top3 = data |> sort |> reverse |> take(3)
print("Top 3: {top3}")

name: Map / Filter / Reduce
description: Process a list of orders using functional pipeline operations
code:
// Pipeline with Map/Filter/Reduce
let orders = [
  {item: "Coffee", price: 4.50, qty: 2},
  {item: "Muffin", price: 3.00, qty: 1},
  {item: "Tea", price: 3.50, qty: 3},
  {item: "Cookie", price: 2.00, qty: 5}
]

let total = orders
  |> map(o => o.price * o.qty)
  |> reduce((sum, x) => sum + x, 0)
print("Order total: ${total}")

let expensive = orders
  |> filter(o => o.price > 3.00)
  |> map(o => o.item)
print("Premium items: {expensive}")

name: String Interpolation
description: Embed expressions directly inside strings with {curly braces}
code:
// String Interpolation
let name = "Arc"
let version = 1
print("Welcome to {name} v{version}!")

let a = 7
let b = 6
print("{a} x {b} = {a * b}")

let items = ["apples", "bananas", "cherries"]
print("I have {len(items)} fruits: {join(items, ", ")}")

name: String Methods
description: Built-in string operations: split, join, replace, trim, and more
code:
// String Methods
let s = "Hello, World!"
print("Upper: {upper(s)}")
print("Lower: {lower(s)}")
print("Length: {len(s)}")

let csv_line = "alice,bob,carol,dave"
let names = split(csv_line, ",")
print("Names: {names}")
print("Joined: {join(names, " & ")}")

let msg = "I love JavaScript"
let fixed = replace(msg, "JavaScript", "Arc")
print(fixed)

print("Trimmed: '{trim("  spaces  ")}'")
print("Repeat: {repeat("ha", 3)}")
